slot.intent: Deposits at three banks from 2004 to 2008: the challenger passed the incumbent, then the newcomer passed both and led by 2008.

concept: Three named bars rise out of the baseline, step on to each year's deposits as it is read and rest there, trading places as they pass; the newcomer climbs from last to first and is lit red when named.
storyboard: 0.5 s, on "Deposits:": the kicker DEPOSITS, BN settles top left in grey tracked caps; the baseline draws down the left and the three labels fade in, NEWCOMER off white, the others grey
1.2 s, on "2004,": the three bars rise out of the baseline together, each value counting at its bar's end in small bold mono, one size for all; 2004 fades in top right in large grey mono
3.75 s, just after "2006,": CHALLENGER passes INCUMBENT, the two changing rows in one smooth 400 ms move, CHALLENGER's longer bar showing past INCUMBENT's the whole way
4.85 s, just after "2007,": NEWCOMER passes INCUMBENT the same way
5.95 s, just after "2008.": NEWCOMER passes CHALLENGER into the first row, and all three come to rest on their 2008 values
7.7 s, on "newcomer": a red wipe runs along its bar from the baseline, its 64 turning red as the wipe arrives, while the two it overtook step back to pale grey, a plain tone change
As each year is spoken its last digit rolls on like a reel and the bars set off for its values in one smooth step, then rest on that year's own figures until the next.
Then a full hold on the finished race to the end, nothing moving.

leansOn.title: Bar chart (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Bars rise out of a hairline baseline as their years are spoken, values in small bold mono beside the marks, grey bars with the payoff in red, no marks that carry no data.

leansOn.title: Line chart (this channel's hand-made draft)
leansOn.why: The marks reach each year's value at one steady pace as the year is spoken, slowing only into the last.
